title: Learn Now, Use Next, Trust Later: Prequential Test-Time Learning for LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.35911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting large language model agents during deployment requires not only retaining past experience, but also turning new observations into timely guidance. Many test-time learning methods, however, acquire knowledge from completed episodes. Feedback from an ongoing interaction may therefore not be distilled into knowledge soon enough to help the next decision. Acquiring knowledge at the granularity of individual transitions could reduce this delay, but raises a separate challenge: a rule that is useful within one episode may not be reliable enough to guide future episodes. Waiting for validation can forfeit immediate benefits, whereas unrestricted reuse can propagate accidental or misattributed guidance. We introduce StepLearn, a nonparametric framework that separates immediate use from persistent trust. translated_title: 即时学习，下一步使用，稍后信任：面向大语言模型智能体的预序测试时学习
translated_abstract: 在部署阶段适应大语言模型智能体，不仅需要保留过去的经验，还需要将新的观察及时转化为可用的指导。然而，许多测试时学习方法只能从已完成的回合中获取知识，因此来自正在进行的交互中的反馈可能无法足够快地被提炼为知识，以帮助下一次决策。以单个状态转移为粒度获取知识可以减少这种延迟，但会带来另一个挑战：在单个回合内有效的规则未必足够可靠，无法用于指导未来的回合。等待验证会丧失即时收益，而不加限制地复用则可能传播偶然的或错误归因的指导。我们提出StepLearn，这是一个非参数框架，将“即时使用”与“持续信任”分离：它将有信息量的状态转移转化为能够指导下一步的假设，同时在跨回合复用之前要求经过前瞻性验证。
tldr: StepLearn提出了一种非参数的预序测试时学习框架，将有信息量的状态转移即时转化为可指导下一步决策的假设，并通过前瞻性验证决定哪些规则值得跨回合持续信任，从而在即时收益与长期可靠性之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: StepLearn is a nonparametric prequential test-time learning framework that turns informative transitions into immediately usable hypotheses for guiding the next step, while requiring prospective validation before reusing rules across episodes, thereby balancing immediate benefit with long-term reliability.
